summary: Comprehensive architectural and visual redesign plan to transform Voice2Vault OS from a terminal style into a Stripe/Linear-grade B2B operations console. Covers 6 staged phases: (1) Theme, typography, and top bar; (2) Live KPI row and 12-column layout; (3) Live workflow pipeline and AI team strip; (4) Approvals inbox and plain-language activity feed; (5) Business data tabs with charts; and (6) Slide-over developer drawer with responsive polish. Zero logic or data contract modifications.
